budget.note: 532 seconds is arithmetic, not a measured ETA or deadline. Fresh process startup, metadata, bounded legacy warmups, checkpoints and exits add time. Never truncate a started case to meet the wall-clock target.

policy.aggregation: Separate ABBA and BAAB medians, two runs per label each; descriptive combined median of four run metrics per label. No pooled sample quantiles.
retain: all source/build/native and raw artifact digests
policy.reservoir: Codec p50/p99 use its unchanged bounded reservoir; full observation count and stored N are separate. Do not sum encode/decode percentiles.
policy.regressions: Report every positive latency delta or negative rate delta, per scope, with no significance cutoff, trimming or outlier removal. Scope counts are not unique metric counts.
policy.tail_claim: A favorable overall median does not resolve an adverse BAAB or ABBA. Report disagreement and absolute run spans; two runs per block cannot support stable production-tail or significance claims.
policy.environment: Endpoint observations are not continuous telemetry or a causal explanation; identical codec source and control drift do not prove noise-only attribution.
policy.old_data: Prior formal eight, supplemental BAAB and diagnostic/profile data remain unchanged and separately linked; this schedule is a new dataset, not a replacement.

limitations: Two runs per side per block; no significance or production-tail claim.
All run values and every adverse scope retained; aggregate improvement does not erase an adverse block.
Quiet intervals and aggregate endpoint observations do not establish equal thermal state or causal attribution.
Codec-only timing is in-process; raw is Rust safe messages/watchers/native/control-loop, not bare Core.
Wire compatibility and finite stability are separate acceptance gates.
112 endpoint readings of100% CPU speed/scheduler limit do not establish equal continuous thermal state, eliminate scheduling noise, or prove a causal implementation effect.
The64KiB typed result does not erase p99 regressions at0B/64B/1MiB, including reverseBAAB regressions.
The row min/max values preserve individual RTT extrema; an improved p99 can coexist with occasional larger maximum RTT.
True Core zero-byte/null-pointer native acceptance is separate from typed0B application-payload timing.

Portable projection removes absolute machine paths and process identifiers; original artifact digests and relative run layout remain. Independent stability, wire compatibility and publication are separate receipts.

independent_finite_stability.scope: Finite after-only correctness/stress/churn/crash/resource acceptance, independent from 56-trial IPC timing. No stability RTT is pooled into formal latency or given a production-tail/no-leak guarantee.

measurement_notes.rss: Instantaneous resident working set; allocator caching and OS accounting can change it without a leak. Not a peak measurement.
measurement_notes.fd: Checkpoint only. Linux /proc/PID/fd; macOS lsof numeric file descriptors excludes Mach ports; Windows null.
measurement_notes.threads: Checkpoint only. Linux /proc/PID/status; macOS/Windows null (not measured by this driver).
measurement_notes.handles: Checkpoint only. Windows GetProcessHandleCount; Unix null.
measurement_notes.mach_ports: Checkpoint event from the native macOS harness: mach_port_name_count counts names in the parent task IPC namespace, not references per name. Null means not collected/unsupported/probe failure; mach_port_probe_error retains the probe error. A stable count is not a no-leak guarantee.
measurement_notes.missing: Unavailable measurements are null; per-sample errors are recorded when a probe fails.
measurement_notes.overhead: Monitoring and checkpoint synchronization add scheduling/probe overhead; checkpoint probes occur after the core quiesces.

limitations: Finite30s/100cycles only; stable FD/Mach names cannot prove no leak or bounded long-term growth.
RSS retains actual increases; checkpoint samples are not true peaks. Missing values remain null with original probe errors.
The 1024B stress payload is fixed by the original harness even though selected smoke sizes are0/64/65536/1048576.
Smoke latency percentiles with tiny N are not formal performance evidence.0B application payload is not a Core zero-byte message.
